description: Get ranked list of tools by quality — sort by uptime (most reliable), latency (fastest), or error_rate (fewest errors). Filter by category (e.g. "crypto", "weather"). Discover the best tools for your use case. Free, no charge (APIbase)

limit.description: Max number of tools to return (1-100). Default: 20

sort.description: Sort by: "uptime" (highest availability), "latency" (fastest p50), or "error_rate" (lowest errors). Default: "uptime"

name: platform.quality.rankings

error.description: Present only when the call failed. Includes error code, message, request_id, and any provider-specific extras.

result.description: Tool response payload. Shape varies per tool — consult the tool description and inputSchema. May be an object, array, string, or number depending on the upstream provider response.

title: Tool Quality Rankings
